identity.name: Live Motion
identity.description: Free real-time live wallpapers for Windows. Every scene is rendered live with 3D scenes and shaders, not played back as a video. 46 wallpapers across landscapes, planets and abstract forms, each with its own settings, Lock and Home views, adjustable render resolution (1%-250%) and frame limit, plus light and dark app themes.

audience_and_problem.main_problem: Your desktop shows the same still picture every day, and most live wallpapers are just looping videos.
audience_and_problem.target_audience: Windows users who want a beautiful, living desktop without paying or wrestling with complicated tools.

branding.logo_description: No standalone logo. The brand uses the plain 'Live Motion' wordmark in a clean grotesk (Inter-style). The app icon is a small picture frame linked by a line to a gear (white on black or black on white).
branding.brand_colors: Near-black #101113 site background with white text; the wallpapers themselves carry the colour (sky blue, teal, Mars orange, Saturn green).

assets.live_footage: assets/footage/*.mp4 (live renders recorded from the installed Live Motion app)

additional_context: Reference video: references/introducing-aside.mp4 (fast kinetic typography, centred words with inline icons, dark-to-light inversion, smooth morphs). Key facts: 64-bit Windows, 1.09 GB single self-contained installer, OpenGL and Vulkan builds, all 46 wallpapers included, free. Steps: install, choose a wallpaper, adjust, press Apply.
